mapper.sql: r.id AS receipt_db_id, r.receipt_id, r.product_code, r.plan_code, r.policy_version, r.previous_receipt_id, r.rollback_of_receipt_id, r.action, r.actor_type, r.actor_user_id, r.idempotency_key_digest, r.command_digest, r.previous_policy_digest, r.policy_digest, r.plan_name, r.vip, r.connector_required, r.daily_meeting_limit, r.agenda_limit, r.seat_limit, r.secretary_enabled, r.status, r.evidence_level, r.created_at
, p.product_code AS identity_product_code, p.plan_code AS identity_plan_code, p.vip AS identity_vip, p.connector_required AS identity_connector_required, p.status AS identity_status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fbs_product_plan p INNER JOIN fbs_plan_policy_head h ON BINARY h.product_code = BINARY p.product_code AND BINARY h.plan_code = BINARY p.plan_code INNER JOIN fbs_plan_policy_revision_receipt r ON BINARY h.product_code = BINARY r.product_code AND BINARY h.plan_code = BINARY r.plan_code AND BINARY h.active_receipt_id = BINARY r.receipt_id AND h.policy_version = r.policy_version AND BINARY p.product_code = BINARY r.product_code AND BINARY p.plan_code = BINARY r.plan_code WHERE BINARY p.product_code = BINARY #{productCode} ORDER BY CASE p.plan_code WHEN 'BOARD_FREE' THEN 1 WHEN 'BOARD_VIP' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

SELECT h.plan_code FROM fbs_plan_policy_head h WHERE h.product_code = #{productCode} AND BINARY h.product_code = BINARY #{productCode} ORDER BY CASE h.plan_code WHEN 'BOARD_FREE' THEN 1 WHEN 'BOARD_VIP' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM fbs_product_plan p INNER JOIN fbs_plan_policy_head h ON BINARY h.product_code = BINARY p.product_code AND BINARY h.plan_code = BINARY p.plan_code INNER JOIN fbs_plan_policy_revision_receipt r ON BINARY h.product_code = BINARY r.product_code AND BINARY h.plan_code = BINARY r.plan_code AND BINARY h.active_receipt_id = BINARY r.receipt_id AND h.policy_version = r.policy_version AND BINARY p.product_code = BINARY r.product_code AND BINARY p.plan_code = BINARY r.plan_code WHERE BINARY p.product_code = BINARY #{productCode} AND BINARY p.plan_code = BINARY #{planCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fbs_plan_policy_revision_receipt (receipt_id, product_code, plan_code, policy_version, previous_receipt_id, rollback_of_receipt_id, action, actor_type, actor_user_id, idempotency_key_digest, command_digest, previous_policy_digest, policy_digest, plan_name, vip, connector_required, daily_meeting_limit, agenda_limit, seat_limit, secretary_enabled, status, evidence_level, created_at) VALUES (#{receiptId}, #{productCode}, #{planCode}, #{policyVersion}, #{previousReceiptId}, #{rollbackOfReceiptId}, #{action}, #{actorType}, #{actorUserId}, #{idempotencyKeyDigest}, #{commandDigest}, #{previousPolicyDigest}, #{policyDigest}, #{planName}, #{vip}, #{connectorRequired}, #{dailyMeetingLimit}, #{agendaLimit}, #{seatLimit}, #{secretaryEnabled}, #{status}, #{evidenceLevel}, #{createdAt})
